# Third-Party Components

Vendored external projects used by the MedAI pipeline.

| Directory | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `LabelCritic-main/` | pairwise mask review |
| `ShapeKit-main/` | anatomy-aware mask post-processing |
| `TotalSegmentator-master/` | TotalSegmentator inference and training resources |
| `ePAI-main/` | ePAI model code |
| `PanTS-main/` | PanTS dataset documentation and download helpers |
| `mock_model/` | local test backend |
| `CLI-Anything-reference/` | CLI reference material |

Each component retains its own license and upstream documentation.
